pins.name: Bryant Peak
pins.evidence: Route has no Summit pin. Surveyed Peakbagger summit; four recent tracks top out within 4-19 m of it.

notes: Both routes are empty shells (no waypoints; West Face grade 5.2 looks too high, every report calls the standard route class 3 via Hemlock Pass). Tracks start at the Franklin Falls / Denny Creek area (OSM Franklin Falls Trailhead 47.41316,-121.44276; Denny Creek Trailhead 47.41523,-121.44337; recordings start 47.4135,-121.4398 to 47.4128,-121.4414); no trailhead pin proposed because neither route names a trailhead. Likely only one real route exists here (West Face / North Route may be filing errors). Reports: boot path off Hemlock Pass to ~4,800 ft, a dry creek-bed scramble to ~5,000 ft in August, west ridge toe at ~5,400 ft, notch on the west side of the summit block; an October 2026 snow ascent found a steep snow-on-duff pitch near 4,840 ft.
